items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: Charles Davis, and I used to go down there, he would speak Italian, with the proprietor, and he would knock 15% off the bill.

ctx.x: You thought that. No. I thought that he had captured the idiom pretty well. Yeah. Uh, the thing that I talked to him about, uh, I saw him. And he was on the sidewalk waiting for that same parade to start on the 21st and I just fell into conversation with him. And, uh, it took me a while in listening to his band to sort of get my ear used to the, that he had a, somebody, uh, I believe his name was Charles, Buddy Charles maybe? Yeah. Uh, playing the guitar. Uh, and it was kind of a beat up old acoustic guitar that…
Uh, uh, uh, they could play pretty loud.
